summary: This 8-K reports routine annual meeting voting results and committee reconstitution for TETRA Technologies. Stockholders elected eight directors, approved say-on-pay, ratified Grant Thornton as auditor, and approved an amendment to the Tax Benefits Preservation Plan. John F. Glick was reappointed Board Chair, and audit, compensation, and governance committees were reconstituted. No special-situation event is disclosed; it is a standard governance update.
